title.en: On the board: the van't Hoff factor

say.en: One formula unit of NaCl gives two ions in water, so it lowers the freezing point about twice as much as glucose.
i compares what we observe with what we expect for no dissociation or association.
Every colligative formula gets i in front.
For dissociation into n ions, alpha is i minus one over n minus one. Ethanoic acid in benzene dimerises, so i is less than one.
Example: 0.1 molal K2SO4, fully dissociated, gives three ions. Delta T f is 3 times 1.86 times 0.1, that is 0.558 K.

caption.en: Ionic solids such as NaCl break into separate ions in water, so one formula unit gives two particles.
